title: The Pomegranate Table for Ants
description: When a pomegranate splits at the end of harvest, the ants lay an olive leaf across the gap. The first pair over carries a single ruby seed to the feast.
alt: Two black ants carry a red pomegranate seed across an olive leaf spanning the split fruit, with an olive grove behind them at sunset.
pairing: Orchard harvest feast × ants crossing a pomegranate on an olive leaf
